title: 第1章 我是谁，我在哪儿-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    【脑子寄存处】

    【小说略有逻辑，以日常为主，不喜欢家常理短，日常细节的亲们，看到这里就能弃书了】

    王野是一个无父无母的孤儿，跟着一个收破烂的老头儿长大。据老头自己说，他是八极拳的第八代传人，年轻的时候还上过朝鲜战场。但王野总觉得这个老头在吹牛。老头还跟王野说，他年轻的时候在战场上，一个人能打十来个漂亮国的大兵。

    从六岁开始，老头就教王野站桩、打坐、练套路。一练就是十二年，不知道是王野资质不好，还是老头骗人，就这么练了十多年，王野都没练出老头说的那种“气感”。

    再后来，王野考上大学，就不再练了。一晃又是十年，王野从毕业到现在，打过零工，扛过大包，当过销售，摆过地摊，辛辛苦苦攒了十年，终于攒出了一个小两室的首付。

    今天，王野买了房，有了家，有了属于自己的家。他坐在烧烤摊上，喝着啤酒，吃着烤串，正憧憬着找个漂亮的媳妇儿，生个可爱的娃，过上老婆孩子热炕头的没羞没臊的生活。

    突然，一阵强光照来，王野最后的想法就是：“亮，真特么亮！不是说三环以内不让货车进入吗？越来越近，看清了，前四后八，你大爷的！这就是飞起来的感觉吗？也不好呀！一点自由飞翔的感觉都没有，唯一的感觉就是疼，真特么的疼！”

    “醒醒，听见了吗？醒醒！”一声声呼唤似乎很着急，耳边又传来议论声：“这么年轻，为了救人就这么没了......”

    王野心想：“什么为了救人？什么就没了？我觉得我还能抢救一下的。”

    一阵猛烈的咳嗽，鼻子嘴里全是水，王野大口大口地喘着粗气。他猛地睁开眼睛，发现自己被里三层外三层的人围住了。

    王野心想：“我是谁？这是哪儿？我的啤酒呢？我那一把血刺啦的大腰子呢？那辆前四后八呢？”这是王野睁开眼睛后的第一个念头。

    一阵剧烈的头痛袭来，无数的记忆犹如潮水般涌来，王野想晕过去，但那阵痛感又让他无比清醒。

    身体的原主也叫王野，和一帮狐朋狗友来北海玩儿，看见一个姑娘落水，那股英雄救美的念头直冲脑门，跳进湖里就要救人。也不想想，就他那大风一吹就倒的小体格受不受得住，人是救上来了，原主也因为力竭淹死了。

    在王野愣神儿的时候，几个朋友搀着他站了起来。“小野，小野你没事吧？”一个比王野高半个头，五官勉强算是端正的小伙子，一边拍打着王野的脸，一边焦急地询问着。

    王野从原主的记忆中知道他叫刘虎，是王野的狐朋狗友之一。

    “没事儿，没事儿。”王野浑浑噩噩地回答着刘虎的询问。

    就在这时，一个浑身湿漉漉的小姑娘跑到王野的面前，满脸惊恐地说：“你真的没事儿吗？”

    小女孩穿着一件白色的连衣裙，瘦瘦小小的，巴掌大的脸上，小鹿一样湿漉漉的眼睛睁得大大的。

    王野看着这位漂亮的姑娘，笑呵呵地说：“没事儿，没事儿，就是喝水喝饱了。”王野开着玩笑说道。

    小女孩“噗呲”一声笑了出来：“还能开玩笑，看来你是真的没事儿了。谢谢你救了我，我叫陈洛兮。”

    王野回道：“没关系的，我也是热血上头了。”

    又唏嘘了一番，各自散去。在一群狐朋狗友的议论中，王野众人勾肩搭背地回到了家中。

    躺在炕上，回忆着发生的一切，王野心想：“这是穿越了，还是魂穿？”
    第(1/3)页

【Brain Storage】

[The novel is slightly logical and focuses on daily life. Those who don’t like short stories and daily details will abandon the book after reading this]

Wang Ye is a fatherless and motherless orphan who grew up with an old man who collected rags.According to the old man himself, he is the eighth generation descendant of Bajiquan, and he even went to the Korean battlefield when he was young.But Wang Ye always felt that the old man was bragging.The old man also told Wang Ye that when he was young on the battlefield, he could defeat more than a dozen soldiers from a beautiful country by himself.

Since he was six years old, the old man taught Wang Ye how to stand, meditate, and practice routines.I have been practicing for twelve years. I don’t know whether Wang Ye has poor qualifications or the old man is a liar. After practicing for more than ten years, Wang Ye has not developed the "qi" that the old man said.

Later, when Wang Ye was admitted to college, he stopped practicing.Fast forward ten years. From graduation to now, Wang Ye has worked odd jobs, carried large bags, worked as a salesperson, and run a street vendor. After ten years of hard work, Wang Ye finally saved a down payment for a small two-bedroom apartment.

Today, Wang Ye bought a house, a home, and a home of his own.He was sitting at the barbecue stall, drinking beer and eating skewers. He was looking forward to finding a beautiful wife, giving birth to a lovely baby, and living a shameless life with his wife and children on the hot bed.

Suddenly, a burst of bright light came, and Wang Ye's last thought was: "It's bright, it's so bright! Didn't it say that trucks are not allowed to enter within the third ring road? It's getting closer and closer, and I can see clearly, four in front and eight in back, your uncle! Is this what it feels like to fly? It's not good! There is no feeling of free flying at all, the only feeling is pain, it really hurts!"

"Wake up, did you hear that? Wake up!" The calls seemed to be in a hurry, and there were comments in the ears: "You are so young, and you died just to save others..."

Wang Ye thought: "Why save people? Nothing is gone? I think I can still save a little bit."

There was a violent cough, and his nose and mouth were full of water. Wang Ye gasped for air.He opened his eyes suddenly and found that he was surrounded by people from three floors inside and three outside.

Wang Ye thought: "Who am I? Where am I? Where is my beer? Where is my bloody waist? Where is that car with four wheels in the front and eight wheels in the back?" This was Wang Ye's first thought after opening his eyes.

A severe headache hit him, and countless memories came flooding back. Wang Ye wanted to faint, but the pain kept him awake.

The original owner of the body, also named Wang Ye, came to Beihai to play with a group of friends. When he saw a girl falling into the water, the thought of a hero saving the beauty rushed into his head, and he jumped into the lake to save her.He didn't even think about whether his small body could withstand the strong wind and fell over. Although he was rescued, the original owner drowned due to exhaustion.

When Wang Ye was stunned, several friends helped him stand up."Xiaoye, Xiaoye, are you okay?" A young man who was half a head taller than Wang Ye and whose facial features could barely be considered regular asked anxiously while patting Wang Ye's face.

Wang Ye knew from the original owner’s memory that his name was Liu Hu, and he was one of Wang Ye’s closest friends.

"It's okay, it's okay." Wang Ye answered Liu Hu's inquiry in a confused manner.

At this moment, a wet little girl ran up to Wang Ye and said with horror on her face: "Are you really okay?"

The little girl was wearing a white dress. She was thin and small, with a palm-sized face and wide-open eyes as wet as a deer.

Wang Ye looked at the beautiful girl and said with a smile: "It's okay, it's okay, I just drank enough water." Wang Ye said jokingly.

The little girl burst out laughing: "You can still joke, it seems you are really fine. Thank you for saving me, my name is Chen Luoxi."

Wang Ye replied: "It doesn't matter, I'm also passionate."

They sighed again and dispersed.Amidst the discussion among a group of friends, everyone in Wang Ye returned home shoulder to shoulder.

Lying on the kang, recalling everything that happened, Wang Ye thought: "Is this time traveling or soul traveling?"
